scope_note: Everything under lucis.life. Vendor infra in scope when it runs Lucis code or stores Lucis data: Clerk FAPI (clerk/accounts.lucis.life), Strapi CMS on Koyeb (cms.lucis.life), PostHog proxy (pthg/ph), Vercel-hosted Next.js (www/app/apex). Out of scope: customer.io (cio/sms) marketing, Notion (career), Intercom (assets-inter), getprobo (compliance) are separate vendor products Lucis merely links/embeds.

Scope/audience confusion: www /oauth/token lucis_ bearer (scope catalog.read) is NOT accepted by api.lucis.life guards - /v1/biomarkers still 403, /v1/orders still 401 with the token. Token is service-isolated.

Clerk pre-verification session: email+password signup yields status=missing_requirements, unverified_fields=[email_address], created_session_id=null. No API-accepted session reachable without email verification. verify_at_sign_up=true, captcha disabled, signup mode=public. Secure (negative result).
Clerk blocks disposable email providers (mail.tm/maxxspace.com) -> form_email_address_blocked, cannot auto-read verification code.
open_threads: PRIMARY/BLOCKED: api.lucis.life IDOR/BOLA. Surface mapped (see api_surface). All object routes require a real Clerk member JWT. BLOCKED on email verification code for peter.bjorn75+lucis1@gmail.com and +lucis2@gmail.com (codes sent, client cookie jars /tmp/cj_g1.txt /tmp/cj_g2.txt, signup ids in /tmp/suid_g1.txt /tmp/suid_g2.txt). Need operator to supply the 6-digit codes, then attempt_verification completes session and cross-tenant IDOR testing begins.

api.lucis.life NestJS backend (success/error envelope, 'Forbidden resource' guard msg). Discovered real routes: /v1/biomarkers(403 role/scope-gated), /v1/orders(401), /v1/products(401), /v1/protocols(401), /v1/files(401), /v1/labs(400 'boolean string expected' - validation runs pre-auth, needs unknown required boolean param; minor lead). /health 200, /v1/biomarkers/public 200.

cms.lucis.life Strapi: credentialed-CORS reflection CONFIRMED (F001) but low impact - admin auth is header JWT not cookies. Content API /api/* locked 403. Residual lead: enumerate any content-type left public via role misconfig once/if a path is found.
pending_decisions: Operator action required: read verification codes emailed to peter.bjorn75+lucis1@gmail.com and peter.bjorn75+lucis2@gmail.com (Clerk 'Lucis platform' sign-up codes) and supply them, OR provide a valid app.lucis.life Clerk session JWT. Email verification cannot be automated (disposable mail blocked). Codes expire ~10 min; re-prepare on demand.

findings.summary: Strapi reflects arbitrary/null Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true. Misconfig confirmed; impact limited because admin auth is header JWT (no cookies to steal).
